snippet.title: Deep Sheol [trailer] PC/Steam Deck
snippet.description:
Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3998990/Deep_Sheol/

In a grim dystopian world, Agent Seth fights through a corporate facility swarming with ferocious monsters unleashed by a toxic biological gas. Demo coming soon – ready your weapons!
